read.thesis: Off-price retailer beat Q2 and raised FY27 EPS to $5.15–$5.20 on HomeGoods and international strength, while Marmaxx comped just 1% on self-inflicted mix issues; store target raised to 7,500.

triggers.label: FY27 EPS raised to $5.15–$5.20
triggers.quote: we are increasing our full year adjusted diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $5.15 to $5.20

triggers.label: Long-term store target raised 500 to 7,500
triggers.quote: we are increasing our long term store growth potential by 500 stores to a total of 7.5 thousand stores

triggers.label: Marmaxx comp only 1%
triggers.quote: comp sales increased 1% and were entirely driven by a higher average basket

triggers.label: Freight driver shortage and fuel headwind in H2
triggers.quote: they are seeing less driver availability, which is driving up price

guidance.quote: we are increasing our full year adjusted diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $5.15 to $5.20
We are increasing our full year adjusted pretax profit margin guidance to be in the range of 12% to 12.1%
We expect full year consolidated sales to be in the range of $63.4 billion to $63.8 billion
We continue to expect overall comp sales growth of 3% to 4%.
we are expecting third quarter adjusted diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $1.30 to $1.32
adjusted diluted earnings per share to be in the range of $1.44 to $1.47
we are planning to accelerate our store openings to 4% starting next year

red_flags.label: Marmaxx execution miss, comp 1% vs 2-3% norm
red_flags.quote: we believe we could have executed our store mix better

red_flags.label: Tariff refund one-offs flatter reported EPS
red_flags.quote: excludes the benefit from tariff refunds that we received in the second quarter and expect to receive in the third quarter

evasions.quote: I cannot give you the, exact thing.
it is probably gonna moderate a little bit, and that is our best guess.
